complete_clauses.working_reading: But the engraving persists, and the grape seed persists.
complete_clauses.reduction: DiscourseContrast(previous=parent C09 final attributed OTHER_EFFECTS_UNSPECIFIED assertion, following=AND(PERSISTS(I,assembly_interval),PERSISTS(G,assembly_interval))). The final source-section closure is not treated as another physical assertion. This is a new commentary relationship, not a claim that unspecified effects destroy objects.

complete_clauses.working_reading: As regards the stone, the source protection claim is expressed conditionally: if that stone with the selected materials is enclosed and worn by the same wearer.
complete_clauses.reduction: Topic S1=the inherited S. Construct ordered accompaniment WITH(S2,SELECTED_MATERIALS={G,P}) with S2=S1. Resolve A as the unique already planned assembly whose components are exactly {S2,G,P}; do not identify A with S2. Resolve W2=SAME(WEARER)=the inherited W. Append CLAIM(IF(ENCLOSED(A) AND WORN_BY(A,W2),PROTECTS(A,W2,Q))), Q=the unchanged previous-ailment chapter reference. The two explicit STONE tokens remain S; the first is a topic and the second a physical member. The implicit claim bearer A and ailment argument Q are a new construction, not contained in the STONE denotation. No physical enclosure, wearing or health mutation occurs in this clause.

complete_clauses.working_reading: Require that the unchanged engraving remain hosted on the stone throughout assembly.
complete_clauses.reduction: Resolve the implicit depiction argument to I from THE_ENGRAVING in C10; require THROUGHOUT(assembly_interval,UNCHANGED_IDENTITY(I) AND HOSTED_BY(I,S)). ASSEMBLY is exactly the original gathering-and-enclosing process, with no new shorter interval. Postposed REQUIRE declares the invariant before the joint plan is executed.

complete_clauses.working_reading: But keep the wing-tip from the selected bird kind under that same carrier after assembly.
complete_clauses.reduction: DiscourseContrast(previous=C12 depiction-host invariant, following=KEEP(P,UNDER(P,S),AFTER(assembly_interval))). SAME(CARRIER_REFERENCE)=S. Evaluate the inherited WING_TIP_OF on SELECTED_BIRD_KIND; resolve its unique already available branch part to P, introducing no extra part. ASSEMBLY denotes the very same process as C12. AFTER begins only after gathering/enclosure completes, so this does not assert that loose P was already below S before placement.

okeey.meaning: The argument retains its individual identity across the named assembly process. Same predicate for the engraving I and grape seed G; neither continued loose availability nor unchanged position is asserted.

keey.meaning: Conjoin the two adjacent assertions. A new whole-word synonym of y, openly counted.

dalkedy.meaning: Introduce the condition inside an attributed protection proposition. IF C THEN PROTECTS(A,W,Q), not the converse and not actual efficacy.

yteedy.meaning: The already specified two-member material group {G,P}; P is the physical part of the current E or H branch. This fixed group-reference macro is one new value and introduces no object.

qokeed.meaning: The existing assembly A is physically enclosed. This is a state predicate, not a second ENCLOSE action and not a goal quotation.

y.meaning: Conjoin two adjacent state predicates. Same logical conjunction as keey; the synonym is not inferred from spelling.

qokey.meaning: The existing assembly A is worn, with the wearer supplied by BY. This is a state predicate, not a new wearing action.

otedy.meaning: Bind the immediately following Person as the wearer argument of WORN_STATE.

cheodar.meaning: The implicit engraving argument retains its identity; this does not assert unchanged material composition, shape or position of every object.

cheey.meaning: The depiction argument is hosted on the physical carrier argument, with the same host relation as the parent engraving operation.

yched.meaning: Universally quantify the preceding invariant over states in the explicitly named ASSEMBLY interval of the finite instruction trace.

chockhey.meaning: Declare the preceding proposition as an invariant constraint on the instruction trace; no extra physical event.

sheol.meaning: The physical part is below the explicitly named carrier. The argument order is specified by production C13, not guessed separately at each occurrence.

lkeedy.meaning: The carrier S already introduced by the parent engraving instruction; an explicit new reference alias, not a new stone.

oteedy.meaning: Require that the following physical part retain the stated pose over the explicitly supplied time region. Does not create or place a part.

ched.meaning: The source bird kind of the already selected physical component P: E in the eagle branch, H in the hawk branch. This is a new branch-dependent reference constructor, not a constant eagle or a new choice.

keam.meaning: The suffix of the same finite instruction trace strictly after completion of the named assembly process, through that trace end; not all indefinitely possible future history.

old_parent_grammar_contract.terminals: Every exact projected word and space is retained. One fixed lexical entry per whole form throughout all nine lines. No EVA component meaning, phonetic rule, silent filler or arbitrary skipped token.
old_parent_grammar_contract.productions: Exactly the nine terminal-tag sequences printed in complete_clauses, in the nine inherited line positions, with the stated reductions. These are nine freely fitted clause schemas, not a learned general language or an independent statistical constraint.
old_parent_grammar_contract.compile_before_execute: First resolve declarations, types, goal expressions, the C06/C07 alternative and anaphoric references from the complete program. Then execute its imperative plan. Declarative REQUIRE_POSITION and RETAIN are not performed placements or second engravings. A mentioned future physical component does not appear inside the assembly before placement.
old_parent_grammar_contract.goal_scope: GOAL in C01 governs ENCLOSE and its AS_AMULET/FOR_WEAR/FOR_PROTECTION complements only. It records the same operation as later ENCLOSE but does not execute it. No other word or occurrence receives a goal exemption.
old_parent_grammar_contract.choice_scope: ALTERNATIVELY in C07 joins exactly C06 and C07 as the two values of material bird-kind(P). Exactly one branch executes. It does not replace the depicted eagle, change the seed/wearer/stone or cause both bird parts to be installed.
old_parent_grammar_contract.actor_elision: There is one instruction addressee W, identical to both explicit WEARER occurrences and YOU. C07 and the imperatives in C01/C08 inherit this actor. No second hidden person is introduced.
reference_resolution: THE_ENGRAVING is the unique I produced by ENGRAVE_ON(S,IMAGE_OF(E)).
ITS_CARRIER, THERE and THE_STONE resolve S; SAME enforces identity, not merely stone kind.
SELECTED BIRD_PART creates component role P; C06/C07 resolve its provenance to E or H.
THAT_PART in C07 resolves this MaterialPart role, never the Depiction role I.
THAT_ASSEMBLY resolves A, which contains the same S and the selected physical components.
ALL_PREVIOUS AILMENTS remains a source chapter backreference, not a free disease-choice parameter.
recurring_new_forms: aiin=OF at both .10 positions; typed arguments distinguish representation provenance from material provenance.
dal=WITH at both .14 positions; groups distinct materials or accompanies the carrier, without fusing them.
shcthy=PLACES at .14 and .15; same pose-consuming operation in the two material alternatives.
old_parent_grammar_contract.inverse: Keep a source locator for every terminal and reduction. An exact projected-text inverse checks coverage only; it cannot prove the proposed meanings or settle three raw forms.
old_parent_grammar_contract.uniform_WITH: Both dal tokens denote the same binary accompaniment relation WITH(left,right). C06 has WITH(P,G) as the material group and WITH(group,S) as its carrier frame. The fixed clause production assigns those typed argument positions; neither WITH occurrence executes placement or fuses objects.

old_commentary_grammar.productions: Exactly the four consecutive terminal sequences C10-C13 above: 6,12,6,9 groups. No token is skipped; the .45/.46 and .46/.47 line seams are crossed only where the fixed clause span explicitly says so. All manuscript word groups remain separate.
old_commentary_grammar.not_general_grammar: Four freely fitted productions are added to the original nine. No claim of learned grammar, component semantics, phonetics or arbitrary new clause coverage.
old_commentary_grammar.mode: New clauses are discourse and declarative constraints on the same hypothetical execution of the old recipe, not a second making/wearing. Compile their explicit references before inspecting the original plan, following the original compile-before-execute convention.
old_commentary_grammar.word_uniformity: Every exact old word retains its complete old denotation. okeey uses one identity-persistence predicate at both occurrences; qokedy is the same S three times; okedy is the same identity operator applied to W and S; al is the same gathering/enclosing process twice. No form receives a per-occurrence meaning.
old_commentary_grammar.inverse: Concatenating the four word lists reproduces every raw ZL group, its source ID and its order. This document property is not a semantic result or resolution of uncertain seams.

old_commentary_binding_assumptions.assumption: Across physical leaves 83 and 108, all repeated referring expressions denote the same particular S,I,G,P,A,W, the same hypothetical making plan and the same source chapter. No manuscript crossreference independently establishes this long-distance identity. E/H are alternative executions; their P individuals are not one animal changing species.

Initial BUT takes the last attributed assertion of parent C09 (other effects unspecified) as the preceding assertion; the subsequent section closure is not another physical assertion. Its following invariant contrasts an attributed-effect topic with retained object identities. This weak discourse fit is declared, not treated as a proof or negation of the source effects.

The bare PERSISTS predicates in C10 take the same assembly interval explicitly named later in C12/C13. Their scope is identity, not loose availability or placement; I and G have distinct sorts but both have individual identity.

C11 is a stone-topic claim frame. Its first STONE is a topic, not the PROTECTS subject. Resolve A uniquely from the old planned component set {S,G,P}; resolve Q to the old complete previous-ailment reference. The missing overt A/Q terminals are an explicit grammatical anaphora cost. S never becomes A.

SELECTED_MATERIALS refers exactly to {G,P}. WITH(S,{G,P}) preserves separate object identities and is used to specify the component members. No equality between ordered WITH(S,group) and old WITH(group,S), nor generic commutativity, is assumed. The clause production compares their named members to the already planned A.

ENCLOSED_STATE and WORN_STATE take A supplied by the frame, not S or the group as a fresh composite. BY SAME WEARER supplies the unchanged W. No enclosure/wearing action is performed by these state words.

IF scopes over the attributed protection proposition: CLAIM(C=>PROTECTS(A,W,Q)). The original unconditional C08 attribution remains. This source-context paraphrase adds a conditional claim record; it does not infer actual protection or necessity of the condition and is not a literal additional sentence in I.1.39.

The omitted argument of UNCHANGED_IDENTITY and HOSTED_BY in C12 is the unique I explicitly named by THE_ENGRAVING in C10; it is not G or P. Postposed REQUIRE governs the whole identity/host conjunction.

WING_TIP_OF(SELECTED_BIRD_KIND) in C13 is resolved to the unique existing physical component P of that source kind in the selected old branch. No new wing-tip is created, no eagle/hawk part is silently added, and no bird depiction counts as that material.

THROUGHOUT quantifies the entire original assembly interval, including the early loose-material stage. AFTER quantifies only the finite remaining instruction states after assembly finishes, through wearing/claims/closure. Neither word changes ASSEMBLY or asserts indefinite future permanence.

C13 UNDER is a pose relation with P as item and SAME(CARRIER_REFERENCE)=S as carrier; the prefix carrier phrase does not reverse the relation. KEEP declares persistence after assembly and does not retrospectively place P.
